    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.CategoryTheory.Exact.ExtensionClosed, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    The exact structure induced on an extension-closed full subcategory #

    Let E be a Quillen exact structure on an additive category C and let P : ObjectProperty C be closed under extensions: whenever X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z is an E-conflation with P X and P Z, also P Y. If moreover P holds for a zero object and is closed under binary products — the explicit form of "the full subcategory is additive" — then P.FullSubcategory carries an exact structure whose conflations are the conflations of E all of whose terms lie in P, and the inclusion functor both preserves and reflects conflations.

    This is the third of the three fundamental constructions of exact structures, after the split structure on an additive category and the canonical structure on an abelian category. It is what lets a subcategory such as the finitely generated projective modules, or the modules admitting a finite projective resolution, be treated as an exact category in its own right.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.IsExtensionClosed: closure of an object property under extensions in a given exact structure.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.fullSubcategory: the induced exact structure.

    Main results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.IsExtensionClosed.prop_biprod: extension closure implies closure under binary biproducts, so additivity of the subcategory only has to be assumed for the zero object.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.IsExtensionClosed.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms: an extension-closed property holding for a zero object is closed under isomorphisms.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isExtensionClosed_split_iff and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isExtensionClosed_abelian_iff: for the split exact structure extension closure is closure under binary biproducts, and for the canonical exact structure of an abelian category it agrees with Mathlib's CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isConflationExact_ι, LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isConflationExact_ιOfLE, LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isConflationExact_lift, and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.reflectsConflations_ι: the inclusion of the subcategory is conflation-exact and reflects conflations, and a conflation-exact functor restricting to two extension-closed properties remains conflation-exact on their full subcategories.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isConflationExact_congrFullSubcategory_functor and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isConflationExact_congrFullSubcategory_inverse: an exact equivalence restricts to an exact equivalence between corresponding extension-closed full subcategories.

    References #

    • Theo Bühler, Exact categories, Expositiones Mathematicae 28 (2010), 1--69, https://arxiv.org/abs/0811.1480. Lemma 10.20 is the statement proved here; the proof of E1 uses the Noether conflation of TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Exact/BaseChange.lean.

    CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts P.FullSubcategory

    A full subcategory of an additive category closed under binary products has binary biproducts: in a preadditive category binary products already are biproducts.

    structure LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.IsExtensionClosed {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts C] (E : ExactStructure C) (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) :
    Prop

    An object property is extension closed for an exact structure E when the middle term of every E-conflation whose outer terms satisfy the property satisfies the property.

    For the canonical exact structure of an abelian category this is Mathlib's CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions; see LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isExtensionClosed_abelian_iff.

    • prop_X₂ {S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex C} (hS : E.Conflation S) (h₁ : P S.X₁) (h₃ : P S.X₃) : P S.X₂

      The middle term of a conflation with outer terms in P lies in P.

      P.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts

      A replete extension-closed property is closed under binary products. Together with CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ContainsZero this is exactly the additivity of the full subcategory, so no separate closure hypothesis on biproducts is needed.

      source
      theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.IsExtensionClosed.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts C] {E : ExactStructure C} {P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C} (hP : E.IsExtensionClosed P) [P.ContainsZero] :
      P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms

      An extension-closed property holding for some zero object is closed under isomorphisms: an isomorphism X ≅ Y followed by the zero map to a zero object is a split conflation.

      theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.isExtensionClosed_split_iff {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts C] (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] :
      (split C).IsExtensionClosed P ↔ ∀ (X Y : C), P X → P Y → P (X ⊞ Y)

      For the split exact structure, extension closure is exactly closure under binary biproducts. This is the hypothesis under which a subcategory such as the finitely generated projective modules inherits the split structure.

      noncomputable def LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.fullSubcategory {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts C] {E : ExactStructure C} (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) [P.ContainsZero] [P.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts] (hP : E.IsExtensionClosed P) :
      ExactStructure P.FullSubcategory

      The exact structure induced on an extension-closed full subcategory. Its conflations are the conflations of E all of whose terms lie in P.

      The subcategory is required to be additive in the explicit form of containing a zero object and being closed under binary products; by LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.ExactStructure.IsExtensionClosed.isClosedUnderBinaryProducts the second condition is automatic for a replete extension-closed P.
